Both value heads were trained on corrupted targets produced by the never-committed 2026-10-20 run-time code.

disqualification.detail: Found by the 2026-10-30/31 checkpoint & artifact lifecycle audit (finding CKP-08): a weights-only container ({model, num_blocks 12, num_filters 128, checkpoint_format 1}) written 2026-10-29 01:07 with no in-repo producer and no run identity, whose stem-conv checksum is identical to the quarantined AdamW snapshots. It cannot be reproduced, cannot be attributed to a run, and carries no optimizer/scheduler state. It is weights-only by construction and therefore can never be a resume point; it must not become a warm start either, because its lineage is the same one this project disqualified (value-head contamination) and its producing run is unknown. Copying or renaming it does not change this: registry matching is by path and the trainer/tools refuse weights-only containers on resume paths (is_resumable_candidate).
